macro_cross_check: Computed over all 16 lines at source scale, 4 servings: 765 cal, 49.2 g protein, 103 g carbs per serving. Source published 465 / 38 / 40, and the gap is fully explained: strip the rice line out and our figures become 477 cal, 43.8 g protein, 38.5 g carbs - which matches the source's 465 / 40 / 38 almost line for line. The source's published nutrition therefore EXCLUDES the rice it lists, a common pattern for a 'cooked according to package' component. Protein is +9.5% against the source on the comparable basis, inside the 15% rule, and the main protein is the source's own stated 1 1/2 lb. As built, 765 cal and 49 g protein per serving clears this run's band (450-800, protein >= 40), though at the source's 2-cup upper bound on rice it would reach about 800 - which is why I took the mid-range and stated it.
